card.name: There after warning section headings
card.fires_on: The word "There" starting the first sentence right after a numbered Warnings and Precautions heading (such as 5.4 Acute Renal Failure). It predicts "have been reports".

modes.description: "There" opens the text of a numbered warning subsection, directly after the condition name.
